title: Payment Portal Failure – Student Support Procedure
notice: This is a sample policy created only for the Agentic AI Engineering assignment scenario. It is not an officially approved AIDTM policy. Confirm and replace it with institute-approved wording before any real deployment.

rules.topic: Portal failure on or before the payment due date
rules.rule: If a student is unable to complete a fee payment because the payment portal is unavailable or returns a technical error, the student may complete the payment on the next working day, provided the issue is reported before the original due-date deadline.

The student should retain a screenshot of the error, the transaction/reference number, and the date and time of the failed attempt. The student should include these details when raising a support request.

rules.topic: Late fee during verified portal outage
rules.rule: A late fee should not be applied for the approved next-working-day window when the portal failure is verified from the submitted evidence.

rules.topic: Amount debited but payment status failed or pending
rules.rule: The student should not immediately retry the payment. The transaction should first be checked using its reference number to avoid duplicate payment.

rules.topic: Issue reported after the due date
rules.rule: If the student reports the portal failure only after the due-date deadline, the next-working-day arrangement is not automatic. The case requires review by the authorised accounts team.

student_guidance: Keep a screenshot of the portal error.
Save the transaction/reference number and note the date and time of the failed attempt.
Raise a support request before the original payment deadline.
If money was debited, do not retry until the transaction status is checked.
student_facing_summary: If the payment portal fails on or before the due date, you may complete the payment on the next working day, provided you report the issue before the due-date deadline and retain proof of the failed attempt. If money has already been debited, do not make another payment until the transaction status is checked.
